simple.summary: נֵכֶה (nêkeh) means a smiter , i.e. (figuratively) traducer First listed occurrence: Ps 35 15.

definitions.full: H5222. nekeh [ נֵכֶה ] adjective id.; — plural נֵכִים Psa 35:15 smitten ones , but read probably נָכְרִים aliens Ol Che Bae and others I. נָכוֺן noun [masculine] = blow Job 12:5 according to Schult Di Bu, but precarious; < Niph`al from כון q. v.
